why: Grobid TEI from the medRxiv preprint PDF also in the corpus as medrxiv-2026.08.13.26360411v1: a long genomics paper whose sections Grobid left unnumbered, so every body heading is a top-level section. 9 figures, one per <figure>: Grobid merged the captions of Figures 1–3 into one element and of Figures 4–5 into another, and the other seven are bare bitmap regions with no caption or URL, which the model keeps and the Markdown does not show. 1 formula: the F-statistic, which the PDF's font encoding turned into punctuation; its $ is escaped so the text does not open math. No tables, no footnotes, 79 references. The "!This" heading is Grobid's. The acknowledgments div has no heading, and the data and code availability statements and the disclosures follow it as back matter.
